name: Shenzhen Snapmaker Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen company founded 2016, distinctive for building multi-function 3-in-1 machines (3D printing, laser, CNC) rather than printers alone (Snapmaker 2.0, Artisan, J1, U1). Filament is an in-house accessory line with RFID-tagged spools tuned to Snapmaker's own machines, and the material range is narrower than pure filament brands — PLA, PETG and TPU only, with no confirmed ABS/ASA/PA/PC lines. No third-party OEM relationship is documented and the brand is absent from the owner-verified ground-truth table.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: PLA Basic, SnapSpeed PLA, Silk PLA and Matte PLA

additional_notes: Standard PLA around $23/kg. Build plates and other consumables are sold under the Materials/accessories collection for the 3-in-1 machines. Roughly ten years in market as of 2026. Whether the filament is extruded in-house or contract-manufactured is unverified; no specific manufacturing facility was identified. Social profiles on YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and X are presumed to exist but were not verified, so none are recorded.

provenance.conflicts: Corporate sourcing is thinner than the other brands in this cluster; founding year rests largely on 3dprintingjournal.com and a Baidu Baike entry. Actual production origin (in-house vs contracted) is unverified, as is the absence of ABS/ASA/PA/PC lines (likely absent rather than confirmed absent).
